v1FindingDisposition.preExistingGuard: Explicit conditional detects existing files, directories, and dangling symlinks and exits before install, units, or Go.
v1FindingDisposition.actualBashConflictResult: All exit nonzero, do not invoke stub units/Go, do not write publication_ready, and preserve sentinel bytes.

findings.title: GITHUB_OUTPUT write failure is masked and can produce a successful CPU step with no artifact
findings.evidence: The shell intentionally omits `-e`. After cpu-publish returns zero, `printf publication_ready=true >>$GITHUB_OUTPUT` is not checked. If the append fails, the following final status test can return zero when units and Go succeeded, masking the output-write error. The CPU step then succeeds, publication_ready is absent, and the conditionally gated upload is silently skipped; if-no-files-found:error never runs.
findings.independentCounterexample: Executed the frozen workflow Bash block with successful stub python3/Go functions and GITHUB_OUTPUT set to a directory. Bash reported `Is a directory`, invoked all success-path stubs, and exited 0. No publication_ready output was created.
findings.minimumCorrection: Treat the GITHUB_OUTPUT append as part of publication success: on append failure set publish_code nonzero or exit nonzero before the final test. Add an actual Bash regression with successful units/Go/publisher stubs and an unwritable or directory GITHUB_OUTPUT; require nonzero exit and absent ready output.

independentCpuReplay.limitation: The suite covers pre-existing-path Bash conflicts but not GITHUB_OUTPUT append failure.
